title: How to write a welcome email series, with a 5-email template
description: Plan a welcome email series: a 5-email template with timing and subject lines, AI prompts to write it from your own facts, and the US consent basics.
lede: A welcome email series is the handful of automated emails new subscribers receive in their first week, when they care most about what you send. This guide gives you a 5-email template with timing and subject lines. You also get prompts to write it with AI, a worked example and the consent basics.
